title: A nightly Argo Workflows DAG fails on one region, and finance needs the report at 05:30

lines.text: 04:30 alert: Workflow nightly-sales-8x2kq Failed; finance channel at 04:20: 'Nightly report ready'

objective: Build DAGs: tasks with dependencies, conditional execution with when, loops with withItems and withParam, and fan-out and fan-in
secondaryObjectives: Understand the Workflow spec: parameters, volumes, retryStrategy, timeouts, activeDeadlineSeconds, exit handlers, and workflow and pod garbage collection

sources.cite: Linux Foundation, Certified Argo Project Associate (CAPA) exam page: Argo Workflows 36%, Argo CD 34%, Argo Rollouts 18%, Argo Events 12%
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of the Linux Foundation's page (last modified 2026-05-06). Its Argo Workflows topics are workflow fundamentals, artifacts, templates, the workflow spec, DAGs ('Work with DAG (Directed-Acyclic Graphs)') and data processing jobs; it does not mention retries or exit handlers. A study page (kube-dojo.github.io/k8s/capa, same weights) lists retryStrategy, backoff and exit handlers as study topics. The objective wording is the course seed's.

Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch. A DAG is defined 'by specifying the dependencies of each task'. Its fail-fast behavior, when it detects a failed node, stops scheduling new steps, 'Then it waits until all DAG nodes are completed before failing the DAG itself'; FailFast defaults to true.

Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch. retryPolicy chooses which failures to retry: Always 'Retry all failed steps'; OnFailure (the default) 'Retry steps whose main container is marked as failed in Kubernetes'; OnError 'Retry steps that encounter Argo controller errors, or whose init or wait containers fail'; OnTransientError for errors defined as transient. 'You can configure the delay between retries with backoff.'

sources.cite: Argo Workflows documentation, argo retry (CLI reference, latest)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch: 'Rerun a failed Workflow. Specifically, rerun all failed steps.' A retry reuses the existing Workflow object. A third-party article read the same day (oneuptime.com, 2026-08-02, 'Retry vs. Resubmit in Argo Workflows') adds that with retry 'successful work that does not need to be reset remains recorded', while resubmit creates a new Workflow and evaluates the graph again from the start unless --memoized is used.

sources.cite: KodeKloud notes, Prep Course Certified Argo Project Associate: Demo Exit Handler
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch (a training provider's notes, not Argo's own documentation): 'Exit handlers run once at the end of a workflow regardless of success or failure', set with onExit; the handler reads {{workflow.status}} to decide what to do, for example sending a failure notification when the status is Failed. To verify against the Argo exit-handler walk-through.

brief.situation: You are the data platform engineer on call at Northwind Outfitters, a fictional retailer. The nightly-sales Workflow is a DAG: extract fans out over 12 regions (withItems), each region's transform depends on its extract, aggregate fans in on all 12 transforms, and publish writes the finance report. At 04:30 the Workflow shows Failed. At 04:20 the finance channel got its usual message: 'Nightly report ready'. Finance closes the day's books at 05:30.
handover: The Workflow normally takes about 2 hours from 02:00; one region's extract and transform take about 25 minutes.
Change calendar: the eu-west sales database replica restarted for maintenance between 03:10 and 03:14.
howItWorks: The terminal shows each command's output; the diagram shows the DAG's tasks and their state.
Each command takes a minute or two; the clock moves only when you act or wait.
When you close, you write the record and explain your reasoning.

source.note: Finance closes the books at 05:30, 60 minutes after the alert.

get.label: argo get nightly-sales-8x2kq
get.why: Wait for the running command to finish.

effects.output:
data@ops:~$ argo get nightly-sales-8x2kq
Name: nightly-sales-8x2kq   Status: Failed   Message: child 'extract-eu-west' failed
STEP                     PHASE
 ├─ extract(us-east..)    Succeeded (11)
 ├─ extract(eu-west)      Failed  exit code 1
 ├─ transform(..)         Succeeded (11)
 ├─ transform(eu-west)    Omitted
 ├─ aggregate             Omitted
 ├─ publish               Omitted
 └─ onExit: notify        Succeeded

effects.finding: Eleven regions went through; eu-west's extract failed, so the DAG stopped scheduling (fail fast is the default) and the fan-in, aggregate, never ran. The exit handler ran anyway and reported success.

logs.label: argo logs nightly-sales-8x2kq --node-field-selector displayName=extract(eu-west)
logs.why: Wait for the running command to finish.

effects.output:
data@ops:~$ argo logs nightly-sales-8x2kq ...extract(eu-west)
03:12:07 connecting to sales-eu-replica:5432
03:12:09 error: server closed the connection unexpectedly (connection reset by peer)
03:12:09 exit 1

effects.finding: The extract failed at 03:12, inside the replica's 03:10-03:14 maintenance restart: a transient failure, and nothing retried it.

spec.label: kubectl get workflowtemplate nightly-sales -o yaml | grep -n -A4 'retryStrategy\|onExit\|name: notify'
spec.why: Wait for the running command to finish.

effects.output:
data@ops:~$ kubectl get workflowtemplate nightly-sales -o yaml | grep -n -A4 ...
12:  onExit: notify
61:  - name: notify
62:    container:
63:      args: ["post #finance-reports 'Nightly report ready'"]
(no retryStrategy in any template)

effects.finding: No template has a retryStrategy, and the exit handler posts 'Nightly report ready' without reading workflow.status, so it says ready on failure too.

recover.label: Rerun the pipeline
recover.why: The pipeline is already running again.

then.output:
data@ops:~$ argo retry nightly-sales-8x2kq
Name: nightly-sales-8x2kq   Status: Running
(the 11 succeeded regions are kept; extract(eu-west), its transform, aggregate and publish run again)

then.log: Retry reruns the failed node and everything that depends on it: about 25 minutes.

then.output:
data@ops:~$ argo resubmit nightly-sales-8x2kq
Name: nightly-sales-r7tq4   Status: Running   (all 12 regions from the start)

then.log: Resubmit creates a new Workflow and runs every region again: about 2 hours 10 minutes.

then.output:
data@ops:~$ argo submit --from workflowtemplate/nightly-sales -p regions='[us-east,...]'   # 11 regions, eu-west left out
Name: nightly-sales-p2m8d   Status: Running

then.log: A new run without eu-west: it will aggregate and publish 11 regions as the day's total.

notify.label: Post in #finance-reports: the 04:20 'ready' message was wrong; the complete report is being rerun

effects.output: data@ops:~$ post #finance-reports 'Correction: the 04:20 ready message was wrong. The nightly run failed on eu-west; it is being rerun and I will post when the report is complete.'

effects.log: Finance holds the close until the report is complete.

addRetry.label: Add a retryStrategy to the extract template

then.output:
data@ops:~$ kubectl apply -f nightly-sales.yaml   # extract: retryStrategy {{limit: "3", retryPolicy: OnFailure, backoff: {{duration: 1m, factor: 2}}}}
workflowtemplate.argoproj.io/nightly-sales configured

then.log: A failed extract container is now retried three times with backoff.

then.output:
data@ops:~$ kubectl apply -f nightly-sales.yaml   # extract: retryStrategy {{limit: "3", retryPolicy: OnError}}
workflowtemplate.argoproj.io/nightly-sales configured

then.log: OnError retries controller errors and failed init or wait containers, not a main container that exits 1.

fixExit.label: Change the exit handler
fixExit.available: not busy and (not exitFixed and not exitRemoved)

then.output:
data@ops:~$ kubectl apply -f nightly-sales.yaml   # notify: post 'Nightly report {{{{workflow.status}}}}' and the failed tasks when not Succeeded
workflowtemplate.argoproj.io/nightly-sales configured

then.log: The exit handler now reports the Workflow's real status.

then.output:
data@ops:~$ kubectl apply -f nightly-sales.yaml   # onExit removed
workflowtemplate.argoproj.io/nightly-sales configured

then.log: No message at all now, on success or failure.

writeup.question: For the record: why the Workflow failed and finance was told it was ready, how you recovered, and what stops it next time.

parts.label: Why
parts.criteria: Reads the DAG and the failed node's log: one region's extract hit a transient reset; fail fast stopped the DAG before the fan-in; no retry; the exit handler ignored the status.
parts.modelAnswer: extract(eu-west) exited 1 on a connection reset during the replica's restart. Nothing retried it, the DAG stopped scheduling, and aggregate, which fans in on all 12, never ran. onExit posted 'ready' because it never reads workflow.status.

parts.label: Recovery
parts.criteria: Retries the failed Workflow so the 11 succeeded regions are kept and only eu-west and its dependents rerun, before 05:30; corrects the false message.
parts.modelAnswer: argo retry reran eu-west, its transform, aggregate and publish in about 25 minutes; resubmit would have rerun all 12 regions and missed 05:30. I told finance the 04:20 message was wrong.

parts.label: Next time
parts.criteria: Adds a retryStrategy that covers a failed main container, with backoff, on the extract template, and makes the exit handler report the real status.
parts.modelAnswer: retryStrategy limit 3, OnFailure, backoff 1m doubling on extract; the exit handler posts {{workflow.status}} and the failed tasks.

expertPath.text: argo get: eu-west's extract failed, aggregate never ran; its log: a connection reset during the replica restart; the template: no retryStrategy, an exit handler that ignores the status.
argo retry: only eu-west and its dependents rerun, about 25 minutes; tell finance the 04:20 message was wrong.

scoring.modelReasoning: The DAG fans out extract over 12 regions, each transform depends on its extract, and aggregate fans in on all 12. One extract failed on a transient connection reset during the replica's restart; with no retryStrategy nothing retried it, and fail fast stopped scheduling, so aggregate and publish never ran. The exit handler runs whatever the outcome and posted 'ready' because it never reads workflow.status. argo retry reruns the failed node and its dependents and keeps the 11 succeeded regions: about 25 minutes. Resubmit reruns everything and misses 05:30; running without eu-west publishes a wrong total. Next time: retryStrategy on extract with retryPolicy OnFailure (the default, which covers a main container that exits 1; OnError does not) and backoff, and an exit handler that reports the real status.
